purpose: Upgrade scalar-only generated apartment-detail materials with deterministic lighting-neutral normal and Standard metallic-smoothness microstructure while preserving fail-closed native-4K review. This contract does not award Visual Fidelity points.

target.weatheringPolicy: Cause-based aging remains a separate scene/material layer; this pass only represents manufacture-scale surface structure.

sampling.rationale: Reduce 4K minification shimmer while retaining grazing-light microresponse; actual temporal stability must still be judged from prepared native render evidence.

materials.microstructure: fine low-amplitude extrusion-oriented grain plus secondary irregularity
materials.manufactureReasoning: Extruded aluminum members carry fine manufacturing direction; the aged anodized oxide broadens reflection and prevents chrome-like response.

materials.microstructure: broad zinc-like mottling without glitter-scale pixels
materials.manufactureReasoning: Zinc-coated ferrous hardware remains metallic but oxidation and grime broaden the lobe; no bright chrome fastener response.
Extruded EPDM weather seals are dielectric and highly rough; edge response must arise from Fresnel/light rather than a painted rim.
Exterior ABS/HIPS casing remains dielectric; oxidation/chalking belongs to aging/albedo policy, not to directional baked lighting.

materials.microstructure: shallow wrap-seam cadence with fine polymer/foam skin
materials.manufactureReasoning: Insulated refrigerant lines use weathered vinyl/PVC wrapping; seam relief is material-scale while pipe bends/collars remain geometry.

materials.microstructure: shallow circumferential corrugation signal with fine polymer grain
materials.manufactureReasoning: Flexible condensate hose is dielectric PVC; macro hose routing is geometry and the shallow ribbing is a material response.

reviewFor: chrome-like or materially impossible metal response

limitations: The generated fallback currently uses normalized procedural primitive UVs; this pass does not claim exact millimetre-scale microstructure on every differently scaled part. Existing physical-texel-density QA and actual native-4K pixels remain authoritative.

The same canonical material is reused across repeated assemblies. High-frequency manufacture microstructure is intentionally subtle, but only rendered repetition diagnostics and human 100% review can determine whether synchronization is visible.
Source maps and importer settings cannot prove final filtered BRDF/Fresnel response, compression behaviour, or temporal stability on the target GPU.

Legacy scalar _Metallic/_Glossiness fields can be overwritten by the older detail builder; while _METALLICGLOSSMAP is active the formal material guard evaluates the Standard texture channels. The mapped source range, not an ignored fallback scalar, is the visual contract.

expectedVisualScoreImpactIfRenderedAndOb.temporal_lod_aliasing_stability: must be verified; could regress if the maps shimmer
